items.body: With either auto-install setting enabled and a pinned tool missing, the new `model-quick` recipe’s initial `mise exec` installs the tool instead of failing hard. Neither flag is disabled before this invocation. The flags set later by bootstrap and Rust commands cannot affect their parent process. This leaves task .14’s explicit no-auto-install requirement incomplete.
items.suggestion: Export `MISE_AUTO_INSTALL=false` and `MISE_EXEC_AUTO_INSTALL=false` for `model-quick` before its first mise invocation.
